changes.comment: BREAKING: remove IAiProviderDescriptor.thinkingMode and the AiThinkingMode type — the field was required on every descriptor but gated nothing (real temperature/thinking compatibility switches on the provider id via providerDiscriminatorForId); every external descriptor construction site needs a one-line delete. Add 'none' to IThinkingConfig.effort as the cross-provider spelling for 'thinking off' — maps to effort:'none' (OpenAI, xAI), thinkingBudget:0 (Gemini), and omitting the thinking wire param entirely (Anthropic, which has no off value of its own); 'none' also re-enables temperature on every provider.
